ateret-zekenim/1:_: They do not return it, and regarding the Ramza per the Rashel, there are those who say that it is necessary to return because verse 19 is useful, in the scroll, the Dahanukah and Purim fasts do not invalidate the main thing, and in the Gemara, 11.1a without a mouthful, and K.P. Mori in the 2H, because a Mitzva meal is without a mouthful, and it is not a segi without a mouthful. Bar Baruch:
chokhmat-shlomo/1:_: Seif 1 in Hagahah: some say when he forgot to say al hanissim, etc. NB: See Taz in tractate Berachot who challenged this — one should not pray for a miracle; we already wrote to resolve this in our novellae; see in darush for Hanukkah year 5559 to resolve another way: distinguish between a private miracle and a public miracle — only for an individual one may not rely on a miracle and request it; but to request for the community is permitted to rely on a miracle and request — end, in his reason it is good — examine.
eliyah-rabbah/1:_: [A] On the miracles, etc. In the Aboderam formulas it is about the consolations instead of about the wars Hasmonean Yochanan known as the Hasmonean wrote the book, it has 124 boxes as the number of Yochanan who repaired his box and some say 125 as the number of priests so far the language is different. It should not be said that when she stood over them, she will say later about your people Israel, and it should not be said to make them forget your Torahs, but Your Torahs in no way (the ways of Moses, R. David Abudarham), and in the signs of heroes you wrote the laws of your will in no way. It should not be said about the conviction of a shriek that it is a word but in a pinch and it is the adjective for the nation conviction of the Zemids in the hands of the practitioners of your teachings, even though it is not a thing and the opposite will be founded on the name of the Zemids, who are very mischievous from your teachings, etc. (Beit Yosef). It also seems to me that the Dzdim meant the intrusions of Israel, which at the same time were useful in creation, and we found in the first chapter Digitin Dekamer the Nablus and the Arab about them in the Beit Midrash and they are tools, etc. for this he said in the hand of those who practice your Torah.
eliyah-rabbah/2:_: [b] And some say when he forgot the food blessing, etc. Moreover, in the prayer, if he forgets to say, he must say first that they will be per the will, and so it means in the 16th. He wrote in the response of the Rabbi of Rothenburg, Siman P. to mention the kind of event in Hanukkah and Purim that kind of three is not necessary, since there is no need to mention the event of Hanukkah an, since there is no need to mention the event of Hanukkah and Purim, so far. The interpretation of even though we say, "We thank you, etc.," would be because of a kind of signature and not an acknowledgment in prayer, and since there is no acknowledgment in prayer, it is not correct at all, and this is the interpretation of what the dresser wrote in the sign of the RH, section 12 and 12, and the bread of chamudot that she was surprised about, I will omit the answer mentioned above:
eliyah-rabbah/3:_: [ג] [Levush] In order to include, etc. I say even with vav it means those miracles He did for our ancestors and bazman hazeh of this month (Levushei Yom Tov), and Taz agreed to say bazman without vav.
kaf-hachayyim/1:א: (א) A) [Section 1] All 8 of the days of Hanukkah say about the miracles, etc. It is written in the OH Yohanan is a Hasmonean as a Hasmonean in the book of Josephus 11 Hasmonean ed. 21. And so the Rada Hasmonaean Yochanan known as Hasmonaean. And ita in the order of the world Diochanan a high priest had two names, he had Yochanan Hasmonaean. Who is the Paracha the writer of the Hasmonean Hasmonean Al-F in Hirik. And RL because he came from a family of Hasmoneans. Rabbi Rav Pelim 44 C. 31 also agreed, per the words of the Farach Yaush.
kaf-hachayyim/1:ב: (ב) A) And he wrote Osh in Okh 11 a conviction for abducting the Rish, but it is more correct to have a conviction for abducting Fatah under the Rish. II. MA. Who is the Farah wrote that the conviction of the Rash in Hirik and Della should happen per the memorandum brought by the B.I.:
kaf-hachayyim/1:ג: (3) A) Formulation about the miracles common to everyone in those days and at this time. As mentioned in the GHT. And the Farah wrote Tsal at this time without VI. And so on above C. 136, the letter of the the Master is mentioned there. What you did for our ancestors in those days is the usual formula in everyone's mouth and 22 in C. But the Rada brought the formula that you did with us and with our ancestors.
kaf-hachayyim/1:ד: (4) a) When Jonah's kingdom stood against them, conviction, yes, is the common language in the mouth of all, 25 in the Siddurim, but the Redeemer brought the formula when it stood alone without them, according to what he says later about your people Israel, 25 in the Siddurim. And it seems to me that there is no fear of that. And who is Gersinan when the Israel stood against them and your people Israel in the VO. As mentioned in the GHT. And the Farah wrote that one should skip a word about them, and whoever wants to say Tsal and your people Yisrael in the VO:
kaf-hachayyim/1:ה: (ה) A) The usual wording is to forget your Torah and to transfer them from the laws of your will and S. OH and the Rada wrote that it is not to say from your Torah in Mm but to forget your Torah and also it is not to say and to transfer them from the laws of your will in Mm but the laws of your will and the grammar of a word from your Torah is correct that it is better to say that they forget your Torah but in the word delete it is more correct to say in Mm and as the world says. And the 20th Shatz page 23 AD D'Zal to forget your Torah and pass them away from the laws of your will Yaush and the 20th ben AH P. Vishv Aut 25. And the RL who wanted to abolish from them the rah of Shabbat and a word which are the main points of the Torah and some of the laws:
kaf-hachayyim/1:ו: (ו) A) And for you you made a great name, etc. This is the common wording in everyone's mouth and the Rada brought the version for you you made without va and ou and it is also written in the Sidorin. As mentioned in the same name. Farah. Shatz, page Shakat 4 A.A.:
kaf-hachayyim/1:ז: (ז) A) A great salvation and a discharge like this day 25 is the usual wording by all, and 25 in C. But the Rada brought the formula a great salvation and a discharge by itself. Name:
kaf-hachayyim/1:ח: (ח) A) Establish these eight days with praise and confession 25 the common word by all and 25 in the S. And the Rada brought the version and appointed these Hanukkah days to give thanks and praise before you. And the MA wrote that these Hanukkah days are as we say and give us this particular holiday day. And so on AA letter A DIL and established these eight days of Hanukkah as well as the custom of Akal. And so Ben AH there:
kaf-hachayyim/1:ט: (ט) A) And you performed miracles and wonders with them. But on Purim there is nothing but the miracle of salvation alone, and therefore a miracle and a miracle. As mentioned in the same name. Farah. Shatz Shem OB. And I who see in most of the Sidorin that is written here and here on Hanukkah and Purim and you did miracles and wonders with them and Milta Milta set a model on Purim two times this we have heard, that is, the miracle of salvation and also that they blessed Mordechai with greatness and the 16th Km.
kaf-hachayyim/2:_: b) Name. Says about the miracles in the Behemoth with the blessing of the land and in the prayer with the blessing of thanksgiving. Dcholi Mili Dhannokha Hoda Ninhu. 16 SKA. MB Aut 2:
kaf-hachayyim/3:_: c) Name. They say about the miracles in the Behmaz, etc., and if I ate something that should be said with a blessing of a kind of 300, and about the miracles and wonders that you have done for us in these days, because you, O the Master, are good, etc., and we thank you for the earth, etc. YPL 12, letter 1, etc., in YPL 7H, end of letter 1, like Dvash'a, the sign of RA, section 12, ruling to mention a kind of event in a blessing, a kind of C, in Hanukkah and Purim. The event in Hanukkah and Purim with the blessing of Mein C, since it is a confession in the blessing of Demein 3, and there is no mention of an event in Hanukkah and Purim, except that it is a confession as a prayer, it is mentioned there, and the BD AR letter 2 and wrote even though they say, "We thank you", etc. And so on, AA, O, A, MB, letter B. And see above, C. R. H.

shaarei-teshuvah/1:_: B.S.A. says about the miracles 20 and see above the sign 136 that even a resident can say that you did to our ancestors 20.and what he wrote if he remembers the same blessing 20.and if the Omnipresent mentioned the blessing and finished the blessing he is not allowed to return even if he is in the middle of his prayer and if he returns it is a blessing to be canceled Oh, after all, this is the kind of blessing it is, and K. 1: it is proper to practice, and the 13th brought the words of the Radbaz, just as well as the opinion of the king's scholars, but in B. R. C. K. P. H. stuttered about it. See there and see stated in the name of the plague of David who forgot AHN and was of the opinion that it is necessary to go back and start praying and remember that he made a mistake in the law that in truth OT to go back will stop even in the middle of a blessing. And when one prays, he should be prepared for the sake of alms, and he should also be self-aware that he can prepare well in his prayer from beginning to end, and if he knows how to renew something in it and will not be bothered to do so, see Ibid. From the Rabbi of Rothenburg, p. ibid.:
yad-ephraim/1:_: In Haga 11 21 11 Debra 8 it will be said that after the Most Merciful, he will repeat the same because it is repeated first, as follows: 334 and A. Aboderam to say, "Bless my soul" first, the song of Hanukah of the house, and it is filled with Kmash in the songs of Hanukah 13 and A. in the songs of Parach Shekh 11 21. 20 A.S. and A. in the Sukkah page N.D. 1B and Barshi Shem 25 for the knowledge established by the Rabbi at his time and from there you will see that his words are not clear in A.S.:
yad-ephraim/2:_: Taz s.k. 5: in synagogue in Nodeh Lecha it is thanks, etc. — requires study, for Rama speaks when he forgot Nodeh Lecha and says in Harachaman which is request; if his intent: since his primary establishment is in Birkat HaMazon in Nodeh Lecha — why write nevertheless he may say so all the more in prayer, etc. — also in prayer primary is thanks — what preference over prayer?
